Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the next steps so procurement has what it needs to move forward.

Highlights from the call:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + intent routing for top 5 channels (~1.2M msgs/month).
- Latency requirement: p95 < 400ms for single-turn chat paths.
- Data controls: VPC private deployment preferred for PCI-scope data; hosted API acceptable for non-PCI workloads.
- Target go-live: early July (client wants vendor ready by week of 7/6).

Agreed next steps:
1) Procurement sends vendor setup request (W-9 + vendor form) to procurement@finserve.com — Camila will follow up if we don't see it in 48 hours.
2) I'll send the onboarding SOW + order form for signature (DocuSign link).
3) Once vendor is onboarded, we'll push the portal invite and schedule a tech onboarding session (30-45 min).

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW + pricing), W-9_Instructions.pdf (how to complete and return).

If it helps, I can loop in our finance ops to accelerate ACH setup — let me know who on your side owns vendor setup.

Thanks,
